prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1422; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- It is not fully clear where in the vehicle the claimant was sitting.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection in Pasadena, Texas, and was completing a left turn when the collision occurred. Driver 2 was proceeding straight through the same intersection and struck the driver side of Driver 1's vehicle. A passenger was also present in Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 reported a concussion following the impact. The injury described is consistent with the force and direction of the collision. Two independent witnesses stated that the crash happened as both drivers described it, and photographs taken at the scene show damage that matches the reported impact. Driver 2 also confirmed the sequence of events. No prior damage to the vehicle is known to responding officers. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy. Officers were unable to determine with certainty which seat Driver 1 occupied at the moment of impact, as statements on this point were inconsistent. Medical evaluation was recommended at the scene, and Driver 1 was transported for further care.
